build_provenance.reused_vulkan_provider: None: low-level Vulkan provider, SPIR-V, adapter and runtime rebuilt from current source

sampling_order: Sequential cells; native second process block reverses renderer/model order

previous_refresh_comparison.scope: Matched labels, model and extent; separate sequential runs with uncontrolled clocks and OS/driver caches, not an isolated causal speedup measurement

timing_scopes.native_gpu: Recorded GPU engine work, barriers and matching output copy; excludes CPU recording and input upload/output readback
timing_scopes.native_wall: CPU command recording, submit, fence wait; contains the GPU interval, excludes input upload/output readback
timing_scopes.portable_gpu: Backend GPU event interval across the network; not the complete host-plane call
timing_scopes.portable_wall: Synchronous RGB32F preparation, transfers, execution and resolve plus thin request marshalling; excludes status parsing
timing_scopes.cpu_operator: Host operator interval, not GPU time
timing_scopes.not_measured: Game FPS, real transport/compositor overhead, addon UI/model-discovery polling, VR, HDR moving-scene quality, process-launch-to-first-image

memory_scopes.device_local_bytes: DXGI whole-process alive residency, including harness and driver; not model-only or a VRAM peak
memory_scopes.host_private_bytes: Whole-process private commit, not resident physical RAM
memory_scopes.host_working_set_bytes: Whole-process resident pages, potentially including file-backed/shared mappings
memory_scopes.host_peak_working_set_bytes: Process-lifetime resident high-water; native harness includes whole-DLL vector hashing unlike production mapped hashing
memory_scopes.network_owned_allocation_info_bytes: Phoenix network D3D12 allocation-info sizes; excludes addon bridge, driver backing and transport
memory_scopes.requested_backend_bytes: Portable requested graph/cached-weight buffers, not physical GPU residency
memory_scopes.host_frame_buffers: Sampled vector capacities, not an allocator-wide peak
memory_scopes.nvidia_owned_bytes: Unknown: no equivalent internal ledger is exposed

native_timing_context.scope: 1080p native, full eight transformers once, one whole-network pass
native_timing_context.interpretation: The current GPU gap repeats, but different fixtures/protocols do not isolate a software regression or its kernel-level cause. Endpoint telemetry is not a clock-controlled trace.
